states.description: Waking up, dressing, and having breakfast.

triggers: Person looks at their phone while sitting at the table
rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it in the dishwasher.

next.on: Person sits down at the desk

states.description: Working at the desk, reading, and studying.

triggers: Person sits down at the desk
rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it next to the person.

triggers: Person writes notes in a notebook
rules.action: Pick up the book and place it in the designated storage area.

next.on: Person enters the room and closes the door

states.description: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV, and using the phone.

triggers: Person gets up from the sofa
rules.action: Pick up the can and place it next to the person.

states.description: Cooking and eating dinner at the dining table.

triggers: Person sits at the table doing nothing in particular
Person wipes their mouth with a napkin
rules.action: Pick up the bowl and place it in the dishwasher.

states.description: Preparing for sleep, turning off lights, and getting into bed.

triggers: Person switches on the bedside lamp
Person gets into bed and pulls up the blanket
Person leans back on the pillow
